transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I’ve just been feeling really worn out most days. Even when I sleep through the night, I wake up feeling like my body and my head are still dragging, and then I have to get through my cashier shift like that.
How long have you been feeling this way, and does it happen most days or come and go?
It’s been… a while. About a year and a few months, I guess—maybe a year and three months. Around when our older relative moved in with us. It’s most days, yeah.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you used to like?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really thought about it that way. I still do the usual things when I have time. Nothing really stands out, I guess.
Have you noticed a lack of energy or feel fatigued most days, even after resting?
Yeah… most days. That’s kind of why I came in. Even if I sleep a full night, I get up and still feel worn out, like my body and my head are dragging before I even get to my shift.
Do you ever feel like you sleep for a really long time but still feel tired, or do you sometimes sleep more than usual?

Not really sleeping extra, no. It’s more… I get into bed tired, but then I’m just lying there thinking about bills, my schedule, if everyone at home is okay. And when I do sleep, I still wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
Do you ever find that you sleep for a long time, more than you used to, even though you still feel tired afterward?

Not really for a long time, no. It’s more that I’m tired when I go to bed, but then I’m just… lying there, thinking about bills and my schedule and stuff at home. Then even if I sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down.
Do you ever feel like you're sleeping enough hours, but your sleep doesn't seem to refresh you, or do you often feel the need to nap during the day because you're still tired?
Yeah… I guess that’s it. I can sleep what should be enough, but I still wake up worn out. Most mornings before my shift, I feel like my body and my head are already dragging.
Do you often wake up feeling as though you haven’t rested at all, even after a full night’s sleep?
Yeah… most days, honestly. Even if I get a full night, I wake up like I didn’t really rest. My body and my head are still dragging when I have to get up for my cashier shift.
Do you often feel like even though you’ve slept, your sleep didn’t really restore you or give you energy for the day?
Yeah… that’s pretty much why I came in. I feel worn out almost every day, even if I slept. When I get up for work, my body and my head are still dragging.
Do you often wake up during the night or feel unrested in the morning, even though you seem to be getting enough sleep?

Yeah… most nights I’m tired when I get in bed, but I don’t really settle. I just lie there thinking about bills, my schedule, whether things are okay at home. Even when I do sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really rested.
Do you often feel like your sleep didn’t really refresh you, even though you seem to be getting enough hours of sleep?
Yeah… I guess so. I get in bed tired, but I’m still lying there thinking about bills, my schedule, stuff at home. Even if I sleep enough, I wake up feeling like I never really settled.
Even when you sleep the number of hours you need, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t really get any rest?

Yeah… even when it seems like I slept enough, I still wake up tired. I’m usually lying there thinking about bills, work stuff, whether things at home are okay… so it doesn’t really feel like I settled down.
Even when you sleep the right amount for you, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t get any real rest?
Yeah… I do. Even if I’m in bed long enough, I’m usually still turning things over in my head—bills, work schedule, stuff at home. So I wake up feeling like I didn’t really settle.
Even when you’re in bed for a normal amount of time and sleep seems adequate, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t really get any rest?

Yeah… most nights, honestly. I’ll be in bed tired, but my mind keeps going over bills, my work schedule, whether things are okay at home. So even if I sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down.
Do you have trouble falling asleep at night, even when you feel tired?
Yeah… most nights. I’ll be tired, but once I’m in bed I start thinking about bills, my work schedule, whether things are okay at home… and it takes me a while to settle.
Even when you’re in bed for a normal amount of time and you think you’ve slept enough, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t get any real rest?
Yeah… like I said, even if I’m in bed long enough, I don’t feel rested. I’ll lie there thinking about bills and work and home stuff, and when I wake up it feels like I never really settled.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or that you don’t care about them as much anymore?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that. I still do the same things, I guess. Not sure I’d say I enjoy them less.
Have you found yourself not caring about activities you used to enjoy, even things that used to be important or fun for you?
Not really… I mean, I still do the same things. I haven’t noticed that I stopped caring about them or anything.
Even when you’re in bed for a normal amount of time and you think you’ve slept enough, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t get any real rest?
Yeah… I think so. Most nights I’m tired when I get in bed, but my mind keeps going over bills, my schedule at work, stuff at home. Even if I sleep, I wake up feeling like I didn’t really rest.
